app.title: Sky Team Online
app.tagline: Land the plane together: one pilot, one co-pilot, no talking once the dice are rolled.

lobby.roundTimerHint: {{time}} to place all the dice each round, or you lose
lobby.sendCode: Send them this code or the invite link.

leave.title: Leave this game?
leave.body: Your seat is given up and {{name}}’s game restarts, waiting for a new partner. To pause instead, just close the tab: your seat is kept for 30 minutes.

tray.realTime: Real-time: {{time}} to place the dice once you roll; dice not placed by then are lost.
tray.timedGame: Timed game: {{time}} to place all the dice once you roll, or you lose.
tray.trafficNoPlanes: rolled {{roll}}, no planes left to add
tray.rerollIntro: Reroll: tick the dice to roll again (once).
tray.swapWaiting: Working Together: waiting for {{name}} to swap with your {{value}}.
tray.swapOffered: {{name}} offers a {{value}} to swap: tap one of your dice, then Swap.
tray.syncPlace: Synchronisation: place the traffic die on any empty space.
tray.internToken: Intern token {{value}}: tap a glowing space for it.
tray.partnerPlacing_one: {{name}} is placing a die… ({{count}} die left)
tray.partnerPlacing_other: {{name}} is placing a die… ({{count}} dice left)
tray.partnerPlacingRerolling_one: {{name}} is placing a die… ({{count}} die left, rerolling)
tray.partnerPlacingRerolling_other: {{name}} is placing a die… ({{count}} dice left, rerolling)
tray.yourTurn: Your turn: tap a die, then a glowing space.
tray.winConditionsIntro: Land in the final round, after the last die, with:

cockpit.enginesFinal: Final round: speed must be below the brakes
cockpit.enginesHint: Sum sets how far you fly
cockpit.radioHint: N clears a plane N−1 ahead
cockpit.mandatoryBody: Place both dice here every round. If a round ends without both axis and both engine dice, the plane goes down.

modules.keroseneHint: Either player · burns its value; none: −6
modules.internHint: Die ≠ next token · the token goes on any of your spaces

kerosene.name: Kerosene
kerosene.rule: A die on the Kerosene space burns its value; a round without one burns 6. Empty tank: you lose.

kerosene-leak.name: Kerosene leak
kerosene-leak.rule: No Kerosene space: each round burns the difference between the engine dice + 1.

intern.name: Intern
intern.rule: A die (not the next token’s number) on your Intern space takes a token; place it like a die. Train all 6 before landing.

wind.name: Wind
wind.rule: After the axis, the wind ring turns by the axis tilt; the wind speed adds to the engines.

real-time.name: Real-time
real-time.rule: 60 seconds per round from the roll; unplaced dice are lost.

ice-brakes.name: Ice brakes
ice-brakes.rule: Pairs of 2, 3, 4, 5 above and below the track, left to right, in one round. Pass the 5 to land.

adaptation.name: Adaptation
adaptation.rule: Once per game each: turn one of your dice to its opposite side.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.rule: Each round the first player may reroll one die before placing their first.

control.name: Control
control.rule: Two equal Axis dice: gain a coffee.

mastery.name: Mastery
mastery.rule: Two equal Engine dice: gain a reroll token, if one is left.

synchronisation.name: Synchronisation
synchronisation.rule: Dice on Landing Gear and Flaps in a round: the co-pilot places the traffic die on any space.

working-together.name: Working Together
working-together.rule: Once per round: each player puts a die on the card and the two swap values.

tracks.approachLabel: Approach: {{spaces}} spaces to the airport. Planes per space from here: {{planes}}
tracks.trafficTitle_one: Traffic: {{count}} roll of the traffic die here
tracks.trafficTitle_other: Traffic: {{count}} rolls of the traffic die here
tracks.axisTurn: Turn: to advance, the axis must be at {{positions}}
tracks.speedLabel: Speed {{speed}}. Below {{blue}}: stay; up to {{orange}}: 1 space; above: 2 spaces. Brakes stop speeds up to {{brake}}.

toast.noAnswer: The server did not answer. Check your connection.
toast.shareText: Fly with me in Sky Team
toast.partnerLeft: {{name}} left the game. Share the code to fly with someone else.
toast.partnerOffline: {{name}} lost connection. Their seat is kept for them.

errors.room-full: That game already has two players.
errors.bad-token: Your seat could not be restored.
errors.not-in-room: You are not in a game.
errors.already-in-room: You are already in a game.
errors.game-not-over: The game is not over yet.
errors.too-many-rooms: You have too many open games. Finish or leave one first.
errors.not-your-turn: Wait for your partner to place a die.
errors.value-out-of-range: A die must stay between 1 and 6.
errors.value-not-allowed: That space needs a different number.
errors.reroll-pending: A reroll is already under way.
errors.no-reroll-pending: You have no reroll to use.
errors.bad-reroll: Pick each die at most once.
errors.slot-not-allowed: The traffic die goes on the control panel.
errors.intern-same-value: The die must not match the next intern token.
errors.bad-token-slot: The intern token can’t go there.
errors.bonus-pending: The co-pilot places the traffic die first.
errors.swap-pending: Finish the Working Together swap first.
errors.ability-unavailable: That ability is not in this game.
errors.not-first-player: Only the first player can use Anticipation.
errors.first-die-placed: Anticipation comes before your first die.
errors.no-partner-dice: Your partner has no dice left to swap.

endReasons.spin: The axis tipped too far: the plane went into a spin.
endReasons.collision: You flew into another plane on the approach.
endReasons.missed-airport: You ran out of altitude before reaching the airport.
endReasons.mandatory-missing: A round ended without both axis and both engine dice.
endReasons.landing-traffic: There were still planes on the approach.
endReasons.landing-gear: Not all the landing gear was down.
endReasons.landing-flaps: Not all the flaps were deployed.
endReasons.landing-brakes: Your speed was too high for the brakes.
endReasons.time-up: Time ran out before all the dice were placed.
endReasons.turn: The plane was not turned the right way on the approach.
endReasons.landing-intern: The intern was not fully trained.
endReasons.landing-ice-brakes: The ice brakes were not fully deployed.

win.landing-traffic: No planes left on the approach
win.landing-brakes: A speed no higher than the brakes
